own: Yes, this will be so when setting up team members, and if you've decided that this team member is someone who is able to either set up trades or maybe even mark trades complete, then there can also be a band where you can decide this team member can deal with trades from this size to this size. And then that will have a lasting effect through all the other features you're giving them. So for example, if they can create trades or if they can complete trades, they'll only be able to create and complete ones that fall within that band, or whatever else that can somehow fall within that band that they could do, it'll affect that too.
question: Should each member have a trade-size limit?
